claims.text: Baseline methods include NaiveNN, FANN, and a non-domain-adaptive method using bag-of-words and SVM.
NaiveNN is a non-domain-adaptive CNN trained solely on the source domain.
FANN is another baseline method that also trains on the source domain without adaptation to the target domain.
